extracted.intended_audience: students, scholars, and general readers of comparative mythology and the history of religion
extracted.subtask_description: A comparative textbook-style summary and analysis of creation (cosmogony) myths and concepts of paradise/punishment across multiple cultures, with examples and conclusions about similarities and independent development. Covers Teutonic, Egyptian, Babylonian, Hebrew, Mexican, Chinese, Scandinavian, Celtic, Japanese, and other traditions.
